import numpy as np
t=np.asarray(t); P=np.asarray(P); y=np.asarray(dP_dt)
knots=np.linspace(0.5,12,9)
def hat(x):
    B=[]
    for i,k in enumerate(knots):
        lo=knots[i-1] if i>0 else k-1e-9; hi=knots[i+1] if i<len(knots)-1 else k+1e-9
        b=np.where(x<=k,(x-lo)/(k-lo),(hi-x)/(hi-k))
        B.append(np.clip(b,0,1))
    return np.column_stack(B)
H=hat(t)
A=np.column_stack([H, H*P[:,None], P**2])
c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
print('NMSE',np.sum((A@c-y)**2)/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2))
print('g0(t) knots',np.round(c[:9],3))
print('g1(t) P-slope knots',np.round(c[9:18],3))
print('P^2',c[18])
